name: How long does stairway lighting installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does stairway lighting installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of stairway lighting installation depends on the project's scope and complexity. A simple installation involving a few pre-wired step lights might be completed within a day. More extensive projects that require new electrical runs, custom fixture placement, or integration with smart home systems could take several days. We provide a projected timeline during the initial consultation, ensuring you are informed every step of the way.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies with project scope; simple jobs can be a day, while complex ones might take several. We provide a timeline during consultation.
